title: Capability seeds для native / CAO / Claude-only
summary: Семь capability-record (status declared) по готовой таблице; тест сверяет их со схемой и с bindings/matrix.json (model_set, effort_set, cancel, resume, usage) по provider.
why: R16, I7, I14: prepare отказывает явно по capability, а не угадывает; значения Grok — unknown до probe Plan 2.
rules: Не ставить supported без evidence kind doc
guidance:
Исполнитель: Sol (codex gpt-6.1-sol, implementation/medium) — механика по готовым таблицам.

Файлы `bindings/capabilities/<binding>--<provider>.json`, `status: "declared"`, `recorded_at` — время создания, `cli.name` — `claude`/`codex`/`grok`/`cao`.
Сокращения: S supported, A adapted, U unsupported, ? unknown.

| файл | transport | auth_route | model set/obs | effort set/obs | stream | attach | cancel | resume | usage | tools_native | sandbox_os | prompt_only | skill_delivery mode / per_run | plan_write_prevention | terminal_signal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| native--claude-code | jsonl | subscription_oauth | S/S | S/? | S | U | S | A | S | S | U | false | native_plugin_dir / S | A | final `result` event in stream-json, then exit; EOF without result = unknown_outcome |
| native--codex | jsonl | subscription_oauth | S/A | S/? | S | U | S | A | S | A | S | false | isolated_home / A | A | `turn.completed` or `turn.failed`, then exit |
| native--grok | acp | unknown | ?/? | ?/? | S | U | S | ? | ? | ? | ? | false | unknown / ? | ? | response to ACP `session/prompt` |
| cao--claude-code | tui | subscription_oauth | S/A | A/? | A | S | A | A | ? | A | U | false | profile_skills / A | A | CAO status COMPLETED parsed from the TUI screen (premature COMPLETED is a known issue) |
| cao--codex | tui | subscription_oauth | S/A | A/? | A | S | A | A | ? | A | A | false | profile_skills / A | A | как cao--claude-code |
| cao--grok | tui | unknown | S/A | U/? | A | S | A | A | ? | A | ? | false | profile_skills / A | A | как cao--claude-code (provider id `grok_cli`) |
| claude-only--claude-code | prompt | subscription_oauth | U/A | U/? | U | U | U | U | ? | U | U | true | project_dir / U | U | the session returns a report per result_contract |

`evidence` (минимум одна запись `doc` для любого S):
- native--claude-code: doc `https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference`, perplexity `orch/research/perplexity/Q12.md`, perplexity `orch/research/perplexity/Q15.md`;
- native--codex: doc `https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-advanced`, perplexity Q12, Q15;
- native--grok: doc `https://docs.x.ai/build/features/skills-plugins-marketplaces`, perplexity Q12, Q13b, Q15;
- cao--*: doc `https://github.com/awslabs/cli-agent-orchestrator/blob/main/docs/agent-profile.md`, perplexity Q11, Q14;
- claude-only--claude-code: doc `https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference`.
`extensions` для cao--*: `{"cao_provider": "claude_code"|"codex"|"grok_cli"}`.

Тест: все 7 валидны; имя файла == `<binding>--<provider>`; для пар (model.set ↔ model_set, effort.set ↔ effort_set, cancel, resume, usage) значение seed равно значению матрицы для binding (с учётом `by_provider`).

result.notes: 7 capability seeds + test_capability_seeds; values match matrix.json by provider
